summary: Verified public health, unauthenticated API boundaries, invalid OAuth session handling, and mobile Expo login UI. No test Google account was available, so authenticated dashboard and RBAC-positive flows were not executed.
action_items: Provide a Google OAuth test account to verify session exchange, dashboard loading, drawer navigation, and role-specific controls.
Consider adding explicit testID attributes to interactive Pressable controls for robust automated regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses fallback defaults for DB_NAME and JWT_SECRET instead of failing fast when configuration is missing, contrary to environment-variable requirements.
Frontend interactive controls have no explicit testID props, reducing reliable mobile regression-test coverage.
The Akses / User and Pengaturan drawer destinations render placeholder text rather than the designed functional modules; this was not treated as an API failure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No credentials exist in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Expo public preview loaded at mobile viewport; Google button navigated to Google sign-in. Authenticated flows remain unverified.
rca_of_issue: No runtime defects reproduced. GET /api/health returned 200 with {status: ok, service: export7ai}; dashboard, AI, countries, server, interrogation, and auth/me rejected missing tokens with 401; POST /api/auth/session with a fabricated session_id returned 401. OAuth initiation redirected from the app through auth.emergentagent.com to accounts.google.com without a crash.
